Definition: intensive of G3756; not indeed:--nay, not.
BiblicalUsage: Not, strengthened, is the word of a question that expects yes. Paul asks, Hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world? and tells the Thessalonians, Are not ye our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at His coming?
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced the strengthened no is how Paul asks his hardest questions, and the answer is yes: God has made foolish the wisdom of this world.
